method: Four coordinate-labelled pixel controls from flat Google map, roof rectangle ratios, shared neighbour datum and facade proportions. Estimates, not survey.

plan.calculation: Front vector approximately 9.57 m; rear vector 9.66 m; depth approximately 11.08 m. Adopt frontage 9.67 m (existing shared width) and depth 11.10 m. Absolute roof edge projects about 2 m away from current neighbour datum; do not treat roof coordinate as ground survey.

front.method: Rectified composition from archive drawing cross-checked against current oblique photograph. Shared lower balcony level aligns neighbouring 3–9 first windows; five upper centres spread across flat 8.87 m wall.

roof.basis: Close 48 m Google 3D orbit in four directions and overhead pixel calibration. Estimated, not roof survey.

close_plan.method: Affine basis from front south to front north (9.67 m), and front south to rear south (11.1 m).

junction_correction.height_calculation: (445-355)/(445-260) = 0.486. Applied to retained 3.30 m central peak above cornice gives 1.60 m small peak above cornice: adopted 13.75 m versus old 13.18 m. Panorama perspective and moulding edges limit precision; not surveyed dimensions.
junction_correction.overhead_calculation: Using the recorded 9.67 m frontage and 11.10 m depth affine basis, central rear=(u4.05,v3.59), north small rear=(u7.35,v1.98), south small rear=(u1.58,v1.72). Elevated ridges shift relative to eaves, so retain observed facade centres u4.35,7.35,1.25 and allow approximately 0.6 m uncertainty. No forced centring of the large hood.
junction_correction.construction: Planar tiled roofs, shallow stone fronts, tiled side cheeks. Constant transverse pitches; inferred longitudinal falls join each different host-hip height. Central fall 0.18968 m/m; small south 0.49, north 0.18. Analytic intersections give central rear3.90m, south small2.116m, north small2.045m. Seven-centimetre vertical roof assembly thickness. Hidden flashings and exact structural roof build-up unresolved.
junction_correction.observed_vs_inferred: Tiled returning roofs and relative front silhouettes are observed. Precise falls, cheek material at obscured patches, underside construction and the analytic junction shape are coherent estimates constrained by those observations. Photogrammetry does not resolve flashing detail.

registration.basis: Exact terminal frontage datum of neighbouring 3–9 Nevill. Shared affine shear retained.
